scope: Historical expression/barrier measurements before adopting concurrent status observers. Timing results do not establish complete dispatcher or crawl throughput. Raw profiles and temporary validation copies are removed during the requested cleanup; this file retains plans, statistics, controls, input hashes and semantic-probe results.

plan.method: Independent warmed iteration calibration per variant/case to about 120 ms; compare paired nanoseconds per operation. Rotate and reverse variant order across fixed samples. Identical control module checks runtime placement/noise. No profile instrumentation in timing runs.
plan.allocation: Separate inspector heap-sampling runs retain samples from collected objects. These estimate allocated bytes; sampling cannot establish zero allocation. Profiles are excluded from speed measurements.

moduleScopeFollowup.reason: The first phase passed paths and the cached string as arguments. This fixed follow-up binds the path implementation and cached prefix at module scope to match local-url-mount.ts and test possible V8 constant folding.
moduleScopeFollowup.fixtures: Same two distributions and path styles as the first phase.
moduleScopeFollowup.comparisons: Same variants, calibration, controls and gates; preserve first-phase results separately.

prefix.caveat: Raw results include busy-host intervals. Qualified triples require baseline, identical control and candidate to pass the fixed gates; fewer than 12 are not enough for an adoption claim. Windows path algorithms were run on Linux, not native Windows.

plan.request: Compare the only await of Promise.allSettled with .then and an async IIFE.
plan.methodology: Sequentially await each invocation and verify exactly one finalization per barrier. Calibrate each variant independently to 100 ms, rotate/reverse order, and retain an identical await control. Shared-finalizer ignores the allSettled result argument; captured-resource gives .then a per-call closure, matching resource cleanup. Pre-fulfilled input arrays are reused to isolate barrier overhead; four-pending creates a fresh array and four promises completed by microtasks in every operation. No timers, network, actual DOM or async context hooks in timed loops. Global GC runs before each block outside timing. Allocation sampling is separate.
plan.semanticChecks: No cleanup before all inputs settle; rejected inputs do not prevent finalization; finalizer throws/rejections propagate; async finalizer completion is adopted; every form finalizes exactly once.

finalizer.caveat: Raw medians include all fixed samples. Qualified comparisons use baseline/control/candidate triples that pass the predeclared host gates, requiring at least 12. Approximate 95% intervals describe geometric mean ratios. These are callback/barrier microbenchmarks on this Linux x64 V8 host, excluding real I/O and end-to-end downloader work.

allocations.scope: Separate warmed allocation sampling of the prefix expression, including collected objects. No timing conclusions from profiled runs. Estimated bytes are sampling results; zero samples do not prove zero allocation.
